faq.q: How long is the Marbella family boat day jet ski snorkel combo?
faq.a: The combo runs as a 4-hour charter aboard the Mangusta 80. You can choose a morning slot (10:00–14:00) or an afternoon slot (15:00–19:00). The jet ski is included for the full duration, and you'll have time to snorkel at a calm cove like Cala del Faro or Cala Cortés.

faq.q: Is the jet ski really included in the price?
faq.a: Yes. The Mangusta 80 charter includes a jet ski at no extra cost. You don't pay a separate rental fee. The €4,719 minimum covers the boat, skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, snorkel gear, and the jet ski. Spanish VAT (21%) is also included.

faq.q: Can children use the jet ski?
faq.a: Children can ride as passengers on the jet ski with an adult driver. The minimum age to drive a jet ski in Spain is 16 with a valid licence. We recommend life jackets for all kids – they're provided on board. The skipper will brief you on safety before you start.

faq.q: What snorkelling spots do you visit?
faq.a: Typical stops include Cala del Faro near the Marbella lighthouse or Cala Cortés just east of Puerto Banús. Both have calm, clear water and rocky seabeds where you'll see bream, wrasse, and sometimes octopus. The skipper picks the best spot based on wind and swell on the day.

faq.q: What's included in the food and drink?
faq.a: The charter includes water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, and light snacks (chips, olives, nuts). If your family wants a proper meal, you can order a catering platter (€25–€40 per person) – just let us know 48 hours ahead. No outside alcohol is allowed.

faq.q: Can we add extra hours to the combo?
faq.a: Yes. The minimum is 4 hours at €4,719. You can extend to 6 or 8 hours – pricing is on request via WhatsApp. Extra hours give you time to cruise further, visit Cabopino or Estepona, and enjoy more jet ski and snorkel time. Contact us for a custom quote.

faq.q: What happens if the weather is bad?
faq.a: If the skipper deems conditions unsafe (high wind, big swell, or thunderstorm), we'll reschedule your charter at no cost or offer a full refund. The Costa del Sol has 300+ sunny days a year, so cancellations are rare. You'll be notified at least 24 hours before departure if possible.

faq.q: How do I book the Marbella family boat day jet ski snorkel combo?
faq.a: Book directly via WhatsApp. We'll confirm availability, take a deposit (30%), and send you the boarding details. The Mangusta 80 departs from Puerto Banús – parking is available nearby. We recommend booking at least a week ahead in peak season (June–September).

data.body_html:
Looking for a Marbella family boat day jet ski snorkel combo that keeps everyone happy? This 4-hour charter on the Mangusta 80 combines a private boat cruise with a jet ski (included free) and snorkelling at a quiet cove. Depart from Puerto Banús, let the skipper handle the navigation, and spend the day swimming, riding, and sunbathing on the Costa del Sol. All taxes, fuel, drinks, and snacks are included – no hidden costs.

Why choose the Mangusta 80 for a family day out?

The Mangusta 80 is a 24-metre open yacht with a spacious sun pad, shaded saloon, and a large aft deck – perfect for families. It takes up to 12 guests, so you can bring grandparents, cousins, or friends. The jet ski is stored on the swim platform and launched easily. With a cruising speed of 22 knots, you'll reach the best snorkelling spots in under 20 minutes.

What's included in the combo?

  • 4-hour private charter on Mangusta 80 from Puerto Banús
  • Jet ski included free – no extra rental fee
  • Snorkel gear (masks, fins, and life jackets for kids)
  • Licensed skipper – you don't need a boat licence
  • Fuel, insurance, and 21% Spanish VAT
  • Drinks: water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava
  • Light snacks: chips, olives, nuts, fresh fruit

Price: €4,719 minimum for 4 hours. For longer charters, contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

Typical itinerary for the family boat day

Your skipper will tailor the route to your family's preferences, but here's a common plan:

  • 10:00 – Board at Puerto Banús, safety briefing, depart west
  • 10:30 – Arrive at Cala del Faro (Marbella lighthouse). Snorkel and jet ski session
  • 12:00 – Cruise east towards Cabopino. Jet ski relay races for the kids
  • 13:00 – Anchor at Cala Cortés for a second snorkel stop. Lunch and drinks on board
  • 14:00 – Return to Puerto Banús

If you book a 6-hour charter, you can also visit Estepona or the dunes of Cabopino. The jet ski is available throughout the trip – the skipper will supervise riding zones.

Snorkelling spots near Marbella

The best snorkelling in the area is at Cala del Faro (rocky reef with bream and wrasse) and Cala Cortés (sandy bottom with seagrass meadows). Both are sheltered from the prevailing westerly wind. Water temperature in summer reaches 24–26°C. Visibility averages 10–15 metres. The skipper carries a full set of snorkel gear – just bring your own towel and sunscreen.

Jet ski rules and safety

The jet ski is a Yamaha VX or similar model (4-stroke, 100hp). You must be at least 16 years old to drive (with a valid Spanish or international licence). Children can ride as passengers with an adult. Life jackets are mandatory and provided. The skipper will give a 10-minute safety briefing before you start. No reckless riding – the skipper can cut the session short if rules are broken.

What to bring for a family boat day

  • Towels and swimwear
  • High-factor sunscreen (SPF 50+)
  • Sun hats and sunglasses
  • Light jackets or windbreakers (breeze can pick up)
  • Snorkel gear is provided, but feel free to bring your own mask if you prefer
  • No outside food or drink – all catering is included

Booking and availability

This combo is available from April to October. Peak season (June–September) books up fast – reserve at least one week in advance. To book, send us a WhatsApp message with your preferred date and group size. A 30% deposit secures the slot; the balance is paid on the day. Cancellation policy: free reschedule up to 48 hours before; after that, 50% refund if cancelled 24+ hours ahead.
